description: Hear in-game chat as immersive radio traffic. SITREP runs Kokoro TTS locally inside Nuclear Option with 28 selectable voices, per-player voice and signal profiles, favorites, a player blacklist, and a configurable radio DSP chain. Includes a cockpit chat overlay and in-game settings console, downloads its speech models automatically on first launch, and requires no external TTS service. Supports NO Mod Bar for one-click access to the settings console.
